name: Hasegawa Masato
source:
2nd year high school student.
An overconfident guy who looks down on everybody.
On the first day of school he fell in love with the protagonist at first sight and has been chasing her ever since.
He truly believes he's an honor student, but he's more of a troublemaker that is always fruitlessly trying to be entertaining.
